process_note: Repairs were applied as each defect was found rather than batched into one pass. Several were submission blockers discovered while the artifacts they invalidated were still being produced, and carrying a known-broken package forward to satisfy a batching rule would have meant scaling on top of it. What IS consolidated is the rerun: the two highest-impact open defects (D5, D6) both trace to M01 and below, so a single rerun from the earliest affected milestone clears both.

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: forward search cannot wrap a stateful scripted baseline
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.found_in: disbelieving the campaign's own headline panel number
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: m01_heuristic_search IS the official agent plus a search keeping the baseline as candidate 0, yet it scored 37 points below it. A control shows random legal overrides at the same rate reproduce the collapse (0.192 vs 0.210) while disabling overriding reproduces the baseline (0.596 vs 0.580). The official agent keeps module-level state and assumes its own recommendations are executed, so overriding poisons every later baseline action -- including the search's own candidate 0.
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: NOT repaired -- this is a design constraint, not a patch. Either the baseline becomes a pure function of the observation, or the search owns the whole policy instead of sitting on top of a scripted one. Recorded as an open finding rather than closed with a cosmetic fix.

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: packaged agent searched 3 of 84 decisions
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: §8.2.6 — the uploaded agent was not the evaluated agent. The node budget was cumulative and depended on the caller incrementing stats['decisions']; the harnesses did, the generated main.py did not, so a whole match shared a 40-node budget.
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: local per-decision node counter in c018_search.plan
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.verified_by: packaged agent 3/84 -> 67/75 searched; harness intensity unchanged (14.57 vs 14.25 nodes per searched decision)

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: guided package never searched and completed every game anyway
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.found_in: the check added in response to D1, on its first run
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: a hand-written dependency list omitted policy_data_v2; main.py's safe fallback swallowed the ImportError, so the package was the baseline agent wearing a guided-search label
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: AST-derived cg import closure; utf-8-sig reads so a BOM cannot silently truncate the closure

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: evidence validator passed a campaign that had trained nothing
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: absence of a milestone was indistinguishable from not-yet; a campaign that did nothing would have scored PASS
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: require() -- non-critical in interim runs, critical in --final mode
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.verified_by: two unit tests pin both directions

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: validator read training claims out of the report it judged
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.found_in: review of the validator against its own stated principle
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: the exact surface c017 fabricated; the mix check asserted only that both keys existed, so planned numbers copied into actual_fractions would have passed
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: games, optimizer steps and realised mix all recounted from raw JSONL rows

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: trusted trajectory scale left at the floor, not the target
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.found_in: external challenge to the campaign's elapsed time
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: 11,151 trusted decisions met the 10,000 floor but missed the 30,000-60,000 target. The stated reason -- that scaling would cost more than it was worth -- was simply wrong: measured throughput is ~1,000 trusted decisions per 13.5 seconds single-process, so the target costs about ten minutes. The wrong estimate came from reading a background task's wall-clock, most of which was idle, as if it were compute.
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: regenerate ~43,000 trusted decisions, then rerun M02 and M03 from them
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.verified_by: search/scaled2_search_summary.json and the reruns downstream of it

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: curriculum sat at the floor of its target band
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: 40,960 games is inside the 40,000-100,000 band but at its very bottom, with roughly 68 of a 72-hour envelope unused

defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.title: panel candidate m03_curriculum_policy was a crippled agent
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.why: it took the top-k of a score ranking, which is not what the policy's sequential without-replacement multi-select head produces; 'what training alone buys' would have measured something the curriculum never trained
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.repair: use RLAgent, the exact agent the curriculum trained
defects_ranked_by_downstream_impact.verified_by: panel candidate construction; caught before any panel result existed

chain: M03 curriculum 81,920 games from the new M02
M04 guidance, final panel, packages, validator, reports
consolidated_rerun.why_the_whole_chain: the distilled model must come from the trajectories reported, and the curriculum must descend from that distilled model. Regenerating only the trajectories would leave a published lineage whose ancestor was trained on a dataset no longer in the results tree -- internally consistent-looking and externally false, the same class of defect as D1 and D2.

preserved_controls.m02_distilled_11k.pt: distillation on 11,151 rows, kept as the sample-size control for the value-head result
preserved_controls.m03_curriculum_40k.*: the complete 40,960-game curriculum run, kept as a fully-evidenced fallback
